name: Wash Day
summary: A windy laundry catch game: wheel a basket under shirts, socks and dupattas the sea breeze blows off the line
about: A Karachi lane between two pastel apartment blocks, with pulley washing lines, a sea view, gulls, a passing ship and bougainvillea petals that fly when the wind picks up. Gusts are forecast on a live wind dial, the pieces about to come loose shake on their pegs, and each garment falls in its own way: dupattas float and drift, towels and caps drop fast. Seven days from Monday to Sunday bring more lines, stronger gusts and bigger quotas.
how: A demo day plays on load; press Start the week, Take the basket, an arrow key or tap the lane to take over.
Move the basket with the left and right arrow keys or A and D, follow the mouse, or drag and tap on a phone.
Watch the forecast card and the shaking pegs: the next gust sets those pieces free and the wind pushes them sideways.
Every catch raises your run and the multiplier; catching both socks of a pair adds 50 points.
Three pieces in the dust end the day; finishing a day gives one peg back. P pauses and R restarts.
Your best score is saved on this device, and reduced motion calms the flutter and shaking.
